quest.title: In Search of Lost Time
quest.description: Researcher Broglie has retrieved the key to the central processing station.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Broglie, we have the data from the two monitoring stations you mentioned.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Really? That's great! Please, let me take a look at them...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You give the paper tapes you collected to Broglie...

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: Ahhhh! Yes, this is it, this is it! You two are angels, angels sent from the heavens to save me from my misery and return me to my happy life of ease—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you really have to say it like that?

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: #Well! There's no time to lose, kind {M#sir}{F#lady}! I'll go find my supervisor and request the key to the central processing station! Please wait for me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Just... hurry up, would you?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: An excited Broglie returns after a short while.

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: #{M#Sir}{F#Lady}, I have the key! Now we just have to go to the central processing station to organize the data, and then we can resume hydrological monitoring again!

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: Considering the situation of Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations, it is possible that those fellows from Snezhnaya are also at the central processing station...

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: So please, come with me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't forget to compensate us!

choices.text: And we have to go with you?

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: About that... Please don't worry. If my supervisor approves restarting our original hydrological research, you'll definitely get paid!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, that's a relief!

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: #{M#Sir}{F#Lady}, you're finally here!

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: I have the key! Now we just have to go to the central processing station to organize the data, and then we can start the hydrological monitoring again!

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: Considering the situation of Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations, it is possible that those fellows from Snezhnaya are also at the central processing station...

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: So please, come with me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't forget to compensate us!

choices.text: And we have to go with you?

talks.objective: Go to the central processing station

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: #Here we are, {M#sir}{F#lady}! This is the central processing station, where our hydrology research data is analyzed!

choices.text: It doesn't look like anyone's here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Without any Fatui, we're not needed, right?

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: We can't be sure yet. What if there are soldiers from Snezhnaya inside? I might not be able to see Conch Madeleine again...

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: Ahem, I mean, I shan't ever conduct hydrological research again! Please, go inside with me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fine. Just open the door...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon sees them, {NICKNAME}. Over there! Hey! Stop!

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: If we can put together the collected data, I reckon we'll get some significant results, and hydrological monitoring should resume very soon! I can't wait!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds great!

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Why do I get this feeling that we're missing a part of the data? Am I just paranoid?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are you so unsure? Aren't you in charge of the data?

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: ...Um, sorry. I got the wrong room.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Fatui commander leaves the scene at a speed that does not match his physique.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, did something just pass us by?

choices.text: He was faster than a vishap...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, that's not the point! He's a Fatuus! Why is he here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, we need to go after him and get to the bottom of this!

talks.objective: (Skip) Defeat the enemies in the tower

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: Stop! I surrender! Stop!

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: You... You're here for the paper tapes, right? You can have them all! Just... stop attacking me!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Fatui commander hands over all the research data...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that all, Broglie?

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Um... Well... Maybe? Yeah. This should be all of it. Sure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just forget that Paimon asked.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's your objective here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, tell us everything! Why are you occupying these stations?

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: To... slack off...

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: I'm Malinovskyi, commanding officer of the 34th Independent Investigative Squad.

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: At first, when we had just been dispatched to Fontaine, everyone was quite happy, and the mission wasn't that difficult...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So what does that have to do with you occupying the stations?

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: A few months ago, due to some organizational changes, headquarters assigned someone named Shumilov as my new deputy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shumilov? Right, the platoon leader we saw at Crepes Suzette Station...

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: Yes, that's the one! I can't stand that fellow, but I can't get rid of him... so I look for excuses and go on missions to get away from him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, Paimon's confused. You said that he's your deputy, right?

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: That's right.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, aren't you his superior? Why do you have to listen to him?

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: Well, he is, blast him — but he always acts seriously and makes others do the work!

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: His words are hard to refute, and I can't very well tell him that no one here wants to work in front of everyone, can I?

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: It just so happened that I saw some strange towers nearby, so I told him that we were going to investigate, and forged the letters from the Maison Gestion...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you forged the documents! Paimon knew it! There was no way that the Maison Gestion would let you manage the hydrological monitoring stations!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Any other questions, Broglie?

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: I see. So you're just trying to slack off... No, I mean, you're just trying to get a little peace in this noisy world by occupying our monitoring stations.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Well? How would you rate our accommodations?

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: Um, very comfortable? The scenery nearby is beautiful, too. I usually feel a lot better after taking a short nap.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Right? Especially when you wake up and realize that there are no urgent tasks, and that you're not being watched by someone you don't like. You can just enjoy the afternoon sun and the breeze...

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: It's like waking up from a dream and entering another where you don't have to worry about anything.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: That's how you're supposed to live! It's a shame that you haven't tried the limited-edition black tea in the Vasari Passage. If you get a chance...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, where is this conversation going?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, please come with us! It's time to let the Fontaine Research Institute know what you've done!

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: W—Wait!

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Um, he actually didn't cause any damage to our research, did he?

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Objectively speaking, he even collected some data for us.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: He's just someone who wants to be rid of work and live a comfortable life!

dialogues.speaker: Malinovskyi
dialogues.text: Th—That's right!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, that's not something to be proud of, even when you put it like that.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: #Kind {M#sir}{F#lady}, please let him go in the name of science.

choices.text: Is this really related to science?

response.speaker: Malinovskyi
response.text: Thank you, sir, and the two of you! I swear I will never do such a thing again. I will do my best to slack off on my own!

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: I love how determined you are!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can you not get hyped up over something like this?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The Fatui commander leaves, feeling grateful...

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: With that resolved, I'll be going back to go through the data.

response.speaker: Broglie
response.text: Thank you for your work! Please take these!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is it... really resolved?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whatever, at least the stations are operational again, and the Fatui platoons have left. Paimon supposes it's over.

choices.text: Well, if our requester says so...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Out of options, the Fatui commander jumps into the water, creating a huge splash.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Out of options, the Fatui commander jumps into the water, creating a huge splash.
